profiles.shortDescription: Bredel is a Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions brand for industrial peristaltic hose pumps. Its official range covers heavy-duty and hygienic hose pumps, APEX pumps, precision-manufactured hose elements and accessories for transfer, metering and dosing duties.
fullDescription: Bredel develops peristaltic hose-pump systems for demanding fluid-handling processes. The manufacturer-owned Watson-Marlow source lists Bredel heavy-duty pumps, CIP variants, APEX low-to-medium-pressure pumps, DuCoNite versions, hose elements and pump accessories. These systems are intended for fluids such as abrasive slurries, sludge, viscous media and aggressive chemicals, with applications across industry, water and wastewater, food and beverage, and mining. Bredel operates as a brand of Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions within Spirax Group.

profiles.shortDescription: Brilex Industries provides build-to-print manufacturing for heavy industrial equipment and components. Its official capabilities include fabrication, CNC and manual machining, mechanical and fluid-power assembly, plate rolling, repair and rebuild work, and engineered equipment support.
fullDescription: Brilex Industries, Inc. is a Youngstown, Ohio manufacturing company founded in 1996. It undertakes custom build-to-print work ranging from individual machined parts to large fabricated and assembled equipment. The official capability set includes carbon- and stainless-steel fabrication, CNC and manual machining, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical assembly, plate rolling, stress relieving, repair and rebuild services. Brilex serves OEM and end-user projects in power generation and distribution, metals, heavy equipment, defence, oil and gas, nuclear, plastics, rubber, tyre and wood-processing industries.

profiles.shortDescription: Broady Flow Control manufactures pressure-control and safety valves in Hull, United Kingdom. Its official range includes safety relief, pilot-operated, pressure-reducing, regulating, sustaining, hydrant and naval-defence valves.
fullDescription: Broady Flow Control Ltd is a specialist valve manufacturer based in Hull, United Kingdom. The business traces its origin to 1902 and has operated within Valvitalia Group since 2010. Its current manufacturer-owned product directory covers safety relief valves, pilot-operated valves, pressure-reducing and regulating valves, surplus or sustaining valves, hydrant valves and purpose-built valves for naval-defence applications. The portfolio supports pressure protection and control duties where valve selection depends on the process medium, pressure range and installation requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: BROEN develops valve technology for district energy, natural gas, building installations, and marine and power applications. Its official product portfolio includes ball valves, control valves, actuators and temperature- and pressure-control solutions.
fullDescription: BROEN A/S is a Danish valve-technology manufacturer headquartered in Assens. Founded in 1948, the company supplies solutions for district heating and cooling, natural-gas infrastructure, building installations, and marine and power applications. The official portfolio includes BROEN BALLOFIX, BROEN BALLOMAX and BROEN FULL FLOW ball-valve systems as well as Clorius control valves, actuators, self-acting controllers and pressure-control solutions. BROEN became part of Vexve Group in March 2026 while continuing to operate its product brands.

profiles.shortDescription: Bronzoni Motori Elettrici designs and manufactures asynchronous electric motors in Italy. Its official range includes single-phase, three-phase, two-speed and stainless-steel motors, together with application-specific custom designs.
fullDescription: Bronzoni Motori Elettrici S.r.l. is an Italian electric-motor manufacturer founded in 1976 and based in the Reggio Emilia area. The company designs and produces standard and customised asynchronous motors, controlling the manufacturing process within its facilities. Its official product range includes single-phase asynchronous motors, three-phase motors, two-speed three-phase motors and stainless-steel three-phase motors. Custom motor projects are developed for applications including trains, fluid machinery, transmission equipment and food-industry systems.

profiles.shortDescription: AMETEK Brookfield develops laboratory and process instruments for material characterisation. Its official portfolio includes viscometers, rheometers, texture analysers, powder-flow testers, moisture analysers, toxic-gas analysers, viscosity standards and supporting software.
fullDescription: AMETEK Brookfield is a scientific-instrumentation brand whose history began with viscosity measurement in 1934. The manufacturer provides laboratory and in-line instruments used to characterise flow, texture, moisture and related material properties. Its official portfolio includes rotational viscometers, cone-and-plate and cylinder rheometers, texture analysers, powder-flow testers, Computrac moisture analysers, Jerome mercury-vapour and hydrogen-sulphide analysers, viscosity standards, temperature-control equipment and analysis software. Applications include quality control, formulation, research and production testing across food, coatings, pharmaceutical, chemical and other materials-processing environments.

profiles.shortDescription: BST develops quality-assurance systems for web-processing production lines. Its official solutions cover web guiding, register control, print and surface inspection, colour measurement, process automation, sensors, controllers and actuators.
fullDescription: BST GmbH is an elexis AG company focused on quality assurance for web-processing industries. The manufacturer develops systems that guide and inspect continuous materials such as paper, film, foil, nonwovens and battery materials during production. Its official portfolio includes web-guiding systems, optical, ultrasonic and camera-based sensors, controllers and actuators, register control, 100% print inspection, surface inspection, colour measurement and process-data solutions. Product families such as ECOGuide, COMPACTGuide, SMARTGuide, FRAMEGuide, TubeScan and iPQ support printing, packaging, converting, battery, pharmaceutical, tyre and nonwoven applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Buehler develops equipment and consumables for metallographic sample preparation, testing and materials analysis. Its official range covers sectioning, mounting, grinding and polishing, etching, microscopy and image analysis, and hardness testing.
fullDescription: Buehler provides laboratory equipment, consumables and methods for preparing and analysing material samples. Founded in 1936, the company is part of Illinois Tool Works. The official product portfolio covers abrasive and precision sectioning, hot and cold mounting, grinding and polishing, electrolytic preparation and etching, microscopy and image-analysis systems, and hardness testers with reference blocks and software. Buehler solutions support quality control, research, production testing and failure analysis for metals, ceramics, composites, electronics and other engineered materials.

profiles.headquarters: North Tonawanda, New York, United States
profiles.shortDescription: Buffalo Pumps manufactures centrifugal and sealless pump systems in the United States. Its official range includes vertical lube-oil, naval and marine-duty, absorption, refrigerant, canned-motor, ANSI, double-suction, multistage and slurry pumps.
fullDescription: Buffalo Pumps, Inc. manufactures centrifugal pumps and provides repair and replacement support from North Tonawanda, New York. The company traces its history to the Buffalo Steam Pump Company, founded in 1887, and now operates within Ampco-Pittsburgh Corporation. Its manufacturer-owned product directory covers vertical lube-oil pumps, naval and marine-duty pumps, low-vacuum absorption pumps, refrigerant pumps, hermetically sealed canned-motor pumps, ANSI process pumps, double-suction pumps, horizontal split multistage pumps and slurry pumps. Applications include power generation, marine systems, refrigeration, chemical processing, mining, pulp and paper, and general industrial service.

profiles.shortDescription: Bühler Technologies develops equipment for extractive gas analysis and industrial fluid control. Its official portfolio includes sample-gas probes, filters, pumps and coolers, gas analysers, complete conditioning systems, hydraulic monitoring sensors, coolers and filtration units.
fullDescription: Bühler Technologies GmbH is a German manufacturer specialising in gas-analysis conditioning and fluid-control equipment. In gas analysis, the official product range includes sample probes, filters, pumps, coolers, flow meters, NOx converters, analysers, portable conditioning units and complete modular systems. The Fluidcontrol division supplies level, temperature, pressure, moisture and filter monitoring for hydraulic and lubrication systems, together with oil-water and oil-air coolers, circulation pumps, offline filtration units and customer-specific subsystems. The company has worked in these fields since 1969 and is based in Ratingen.

profiles.parentCompany: Freudenberg Group and Eagle Industry Co., Ltd.
profiles.shortDescription: Burgmann is represented today by EagleBurgmann, a manufacturer of industrial sealing technology. Its official portfolio includes mechanical seals, seal-supply systems, carbon floating-ring seals, packings, gaskets, magnetic couplings and expansion joints.
fullDescription: The Burgmann industrial-sealing business is represented today by EagleBurgmann. The company operates within the German Freudenberg and Japanese Eagle Industry groups and develops sealing technology for rotating and process equipment. Its official product portfolio includes mechanical seals for pumps, agitators, compressors and marine equipment, seal-supply systems, carbon floating-ring seals, compression packings, gaskets, magnetic couplings, expansion joints and application-specific products. These solutions are used in oil and gas, refining, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation, water treatment, food processing, marine and other process industries.

profiles.shortDescription: Busak+Shamban is the former name of the business now operating as Trelleborg Sealing Solutions. The current official range covers elastomer, PTFE, polyurethane and composite sealing products, including O-rings, hydraulic, pneumatic, rotary and static seals and engineered bearings.
fullDescription: Busak+Shamban is a legacy industrial-sealing name within Trelleborg. Trelleborg's official history states that the business was acquired in 2003 and that the Busak+Shamban name was retired on 2 April 2007, when its locations adopted the Trelleborg Sealing Solutions name. The current successor portfolio includes O-rings, hydraulic and pneumatic seals, shaft and other rotary seals, static seals, mechanical face seals, engineered bearings and custom products made from elastomers, silicone, thermoplastics, PTFE, polyurethane and composite materials. The solutions serve aerospace, automotive and general industrial applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Busck supplies industrial electric-drive equipment across Scandinavia. Its official range includes electric motors, gearboxes and worm gears, frequency converters, generators and coolant pumps, with standard and adapted motor configurations.
fullDescription: Busck & Co AB is a Scandinavian electric-drive supplier with a documented history in the electrical industry since 1923. The company operates in Sweden, Denmark and Norway. Its official product range includes industrial electric motors, gearboxes and worm gears, frequency converters, generators and coolant pumps. Busck also adapts standard motors for application requirements and provides technical data and selection tools. The portfolio supports machinery builders, production equipment and maintenance users that need motors, speed control and mechanical power-transmission components.

profiles.shortDescription: BW Papersystems builds capital equipment for paper, board and corrugated-material converting. Its official portfolio covers corrugators, finishing equipment, sheeters and packaging lines, stationery and book-binding systems, passport and security-document equipment, and RFID converting systems.
fullDescription: BW Papersystems is a Barry-Wehmiller company that develops machinery for converting paper, board and related web materials into finished products. The official portfolio covers corrugating and finishing systems, rotary die cutters and flexo folder gluers, folio-, cut- and digital-size sheeters, ream packaging, stationery production, book binding and digital print finishing. It also includes equipment for passports and specialised security documents, RFID inlay production and other paper-converting applications. The business brings together machinery brands including MarquipWardUnited, BW Bielomatik, WillPemcoBielomatik, Kugler-Womako, SHM, Wrapmatic and VortX.

profiles.shortDescription: Bystronic develops systems for sheet-metal and material processing. Its official portfolio includes laser-cutting machines, press brakes, tube-laser systems, cutting and bending automation, production software and smart-factory solutions.
fullDescription: Bystronic AG is a Swiss industrial-technology company founded in 1964. It develops machinery, automation and software for sheet-metal and material-processing workflows. The official product range includes flat-sheet laser-cutting systems, tube-laser machines, press brakes, automated loading, unloading and sorting, bending automation, BySoft software and connected smart-factory solutions. Bystronic has its headquarters in Niederönz and development and production locations in Germany, Spain, Italy, China and the United States, supporting manufacturing customers through subsidiaries and agents in multiple regions.
